```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dlookr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(car)
```



```{r}
comedicationdata <- read_csv("comedication_full_data.csv")
comedicationdata2 <- comedicationdata %>% 
  dplyr::rename( "Edited_BfArM Nummer2" = "bfarm_nummer",
                 "Attribut"   = "treatment",
                  "Treatment" = "Medication",
                 "Parameter" = "labreads",
                 "Kathegorie" = "kathegorie",
                 "Drug_Group" = "drug_group") %>% 
  dplyr::select(1,3,5,6,2,4)

comedicationdata2
```


### Monotreatment data ###########################################################

```{r}
setwd("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/comp dose_labvalues")

dose_data <- read_excel("Dose table_assumed_full.xlsx", sheet = 2)  

dose_data
```


```{r}
dose_data_diclo <- dose_data %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Diclofenac") %>% 
  filter(Attribut == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  filter(Kathegorie != "Cummulative Dosis")

dose_data_diclo 
```


```{r}
diclo_monotreat_unfinished <- anti_join(dose_data_diclo,comedicationdata2, by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")
diclo_monotreat_unfinished
```



```{r}
# Erzeuge eine neue Tabelle mit den kombinierten Medikamenten pro Patient
med_summary <- dose_data %>%
  filter(Kathegorie != "Cummulative Dosis")%>%
  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%
  summarise(multi_med = paste(sort(unique(Treatment)), collapse = "+"), .groups = "drop")

# Füge diese Info wieder an den Originaldatensatz an
dose_data_multi <- dose_data %>%
  left_join(med_summary, by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")
dose_data_multi
```


```{r}
patientid_mainmed_multi <- dose_data_multi %>% 
  filter(multi_med %in% c("Diclofenac+Paracetamol",
                          "Diclofenac+Ibuprofen",
                          "Ibuprofen+Paracetamol",
                          "Diclofenac+Ibuprofen+Paracetamol"))%>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)

patientid_mainmed_multi
  
```




```{r}
diclo_monotreat <- diclo_monotreat_unfinished %>%
  anti_join(patientid_mainmed_multi, by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")
diclo_monotreat
```







### Medication headlines #######################################################

```{r}
medication_headline <- read_excel("medication_headlines.xlsx", sheet = 3)
medication_headline_long <- medication_headline %>% 
  separate_rows(group_code, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(drug_group = as.integer(group_code))

medication_headline

medication_headline_long

```



```{r}
comedicationdata <- read_csv("comedication_full_data.csv")
comedicationdata1 <- comedicationdata %>% 
  dplyr::rename( "patient_group" = "treatment",
                 "parameter_co" = "labreads",
                 "kathegorie_co" = "kathegorie",
                 "drug_group_co" = "drug_group")

comedicationdata1
```


```{r}
# Beide Join-Spalten in character umwandeln
comedicationdata1 <- comedicationdata1 %>%
  mutate(drug_group_co = as.character(drug_group_co))

medication_headline_long <- medication_headline_long %>%
  mutate(drug_group = as.character(drug_group))

# Dann Join ausführen
comedication_grouped <- left_join(
  comedicationdata1,
  medication_headline_long,
  by = c("drug_group_co" = "drug_group")
)

# Spaltennamen aufräumen
comedication_grouped <- janitor::clean_names(comedication_grouped)
comedication_grouped
```



### full_medication (mainmed and comed combined in a long table) ############################

```{r}
comedicationdata2 <- comedicationdata2 %>%
  mutate(Drug_Group = as.character(Drug_Group))

dose_data <- dose_data %>%
  mutate(Drug_Group = as.character(Drug_Group))

full_medicatoin <- bind_rows(
  comedicationdata2 %>% mutate(source = "comedication"),
  dose_data %>% mutate(source = "dose")
) 

full_medicatoin 
```



#################################################################################
### gpt #########################################################################
#################################################################################

```{r}
diclo_monotreat_gpt <- left_join(diclo_monotreat,gpt_full, by = c("Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(Treatment.y == "Leber_Diclo") %>%
  filter(!grepl("_From Start|_From start|DBS", attribute)) %>%
  distinct("Edited_BfArM Nummer2", attribute, labreads, .keep_all = TRUE)

diclo_monotreat_gpt 
```


```{r}
diclo_monotreat_gpt_count <- diclo_monotreat_gpt %>% 
  distinct(diclo_monotreat_gpt$`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
diclo_monotreat_gpt_count
```


```{r}
full_medicatoin_gpt <- left_join(full_medicatoin,gpt_full, by = c ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2" = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
  drop_na(labreads) %>%
  filter(Treatment.y == "Leber_Diclo") %>%
  filter(!grepl("_From Start|_From start|DBS", attribute))

full_medicatoin_gpt
```

```{r}
rest_full_medication_gpt <- anti_join(full_medicatoin_gpt,diclo_monotreat_gpt, 
                               by = c ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2" = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
#  filter(attribute %in% c("GPT Day1", "GPT Day2", "GPT Day3")) %>% 
    distinct("Edited_BfArM Nummer2", attribute, labreads, .keep_all = TRUE)
rest_full_medication_gpt
```

```{r}
# Convert Drug_Group to character in both datasets before combining
gpt_plot_data_monomulti <- bind_rows(
  diclo_monotreat_gpt %>% mutate(group = "monotreatment", Drug_Group = as.character(Drug_Group)),
  rest_full_medication_gpt %>% mutate(group = "multitreatment", Drug_Group = as.character(Drug_Group))
)
gpt_plot_data_monomulti
```


### mono multitreat for all labvalues ###

```{r}
gpt_plot_data_monomulti %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(gpt_plot_data_monomulti$labreads, gpt_plot_data_monomulti$group, var)
leveneTest(labreads ~ group, data = gpt_plot_data_monomulti)

oneway.test(labreads ~ group, data = gpt_plot_data_monomulti)
```

```{r}
n_patients <- gpt_plot_data_monomulti %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, group) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = gpt_plot_data_monomulti,
  x = group,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "liver_diclofenac monotreatment vs. diclofenac with comedication",
  xlab = "Medication group",
  ylab = "GPT (U/L)",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots einfügen
ld_gpt_violin_mono_multitreatment <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = group, 
        y = max(dd$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
ld_gpt_violin_mono_multitreatment
dir.create("plots_mono_multitreat/plots_diclofenac", recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_mono_multitreat/plots_diclofenac/ld_gpt_mono multitreatment violin.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(ld_gpt_violin_mono_multitreatment)
dev.off()
```

### mono multitreatment for peak labvalue ###

```{r}
gpt_plot_data_monomulti_peak <- gpt_plot_data_monomulti%>% 
  drop_na(labreads) %>% 
  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>% 
  slice_max(order_by = labreads, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  # behält nur den höchsten Wert pro Patient
  ungroup()
```


### Diclo monotreat vs. Analgetics monotreat ########################################

```{}
comed_liverdiclo_analgetic <- comedication_grouped %>% 
  dplyr::filter(patient_group == "Leber_Diclo",
                medication_headline == "analgetics")
comed_liverdiclo_analgetic
```

```{}
comed_liverdiclo_analgetic_gpt <- left_join(  comed_liverdiclo_analgetic, gpt_full, 
            by = c("bfarm_nummer" = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
  drop_na(labreads) %>% 
  distinct(labreads, .keep_all = TRUE)

comed_liverdiclo_analgetic_gpt

```



```{r}
comedication_med_count <- comedication_grouped %>%
  distinct(bfarm_nummer, medication_headline)%>%
  # create a flag for each treatment per patient
  mutate(flag = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = medication_headline,
    values_from = flag,
    values_fill = 0   # if not present → 0
  ) %>%
  # add a column with number of treatments
  mutate(total_treatments = rowSums(across(-bfarm_nummer)))

comedication_med_count 

```


```{r}
comedication_med_count_list <- comedication_grouped %>%
  group_by(bfarm_nummer) %>%
  summarise(
    treatments = paste(unique(medication_headline), collapse = ", "),
    n_treatments = n_distinct(medication_headline),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comedication_med_count_list
```


```{r}
comed_analgetics_monotreat <- comedication_med_count_list %>% 
  filter(n_treatments == "1",
         treatments == "analgetics")

comed_analgetics_monotreat
```

```{r}
  dplyr::rename( "Edited_BfArM Nummer2" = "bfarm_nummer",
                 "Attribut"   = "Treatment",)
```

### mono multitreat for all labvalues ###

```{r}
quick_plot_data_monomulti %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(quick_plot_data_monomulti$labreads, quick_plot_data_monomulti$group, var)
leveneTest(labreads ~ group, data = quick_plot_data_monomulti)

oneway.test(labreads ~ group, data = quick_plot_data_monomulti)
```

```{r}
n_patients <- quick_plot_data_monomulti %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, group) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = quick_plot_data_monomulti,
  x = group,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "liver_diclofenac monotreatment vs. diclofenac with comedication",
  xlab = "Medication group",
  ylab = "quick (%)",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots einfügen
ld_quick_violin_mono_multitreatment <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = group, 
        y = max(dd$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
ld_quick_violin_mono_multitreatment
dir.create("plots_mono_multitreat/plots_diclofenac", recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_mono_multitreat/plots_diclofenac/ld_quick_mono multitreatment violin.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(ld_quick_violin_mono_multitreatment)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
```

```{r}
  data = erythrozyten_plot_data_monomulti,
  x = group,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch

  messages = FALSE)

    data = n_patients,

        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
ld_erythrozyten_violin_mono_multitreatment
```

```{r}
thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13 <- thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti%>% 
  filter(attribute %in% c("Thrombozyten Day1", "Thrombozyten Day2", "Thrombozyten Day3")) %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, labreads, attribute, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13 %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13$labreads, thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13$group, var)
leveneTest(labreads ~ group, data = thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13)

oneway.test(labreads ~ group, data = thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13)
```

```{r}
n_patients <- thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13 %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, group) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = thrombozyten_plot_data_monomulti_13,
  x = group,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "liver_diclofenac monotreatment vs. diclofenac with comedication for day 1-3",
  xlab = "Medication group",
  ylab = "thrombozyten (cells/ul)",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots einfügen
ld_thrombozyten_violin_mono_multitreatment_13 <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = group, 
        y = max(dd$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
ld_thrombozyten_violin_mono_multitreatment_13
dir.create("plots_mono_multitreat/plots_diclofenac", recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_mono_multitreat/plots_diclofenac/ld_thrombozyten_day1-3_mono multitreatment violin.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(ld_thrombozyten_violin_mono_multitreatment_13)
dev.off()
```
